name: comp-50
title: Card Details Form
blurb: Complete card details form with number, expiry, and CVC.
description: A stacked card entry form with card number (showing dynamic logo), expiry date, and CVC fields. Built with react-payment-inputs, logo updates based on detected card type.
use_when: Payment flows requiring full card details with card type visual feedback.
avoid_when: You want to split card inputs across multiple steps or need custom card type detection.
a11y: Each field has an id. Fieldset with legend. Card logo is conditionally shown. Focus management via z-index.
